claims.text: The FDA label reports that formal studies found buspirone did not increase alcohol-induced motor and mental impairment.
claims.quote: While formal studies of the interaction of buspirone hydrochloride with alcohol indicate that buspirone does not increase alcohol-induced impairment in motor and mental performance, it is prudent to avoid concomitant use of alcohol and buspirone.

claims.text: The FDA label calls avoiding alcohol with buspirone prudent.
claims.quote: it is prudent to avoid concomitant use of alcohol and buspirone.

headline.text: The FDA label calls avoiding alcohol with buspirone prudent, although formal studies found no added impairment.

reported.text: The label's study finding concerns motor and mental performance in formal interaction studies.
In the same sentence, the label calls avoiding the combination prudent.
